script_text: This week, Leo, the cosmos slams the brakes on your usual roar—prepare for a power surge disguised as a pause. Monday and Tuesday, Sun sextiles Neptune in your 4th House, stirring deep home emotions, while Venus square Pluto in the 8th ignites magnetic attraction; Wednesday, Mercury retrograde in your 10th stalls career moves, so avoid signing contracts. Thursday’s Moon trines your ruling Sun in the 1st House, flipping energy from doubt to confident action. Friday through Sunday, Mars enters your 2nd House, boosting income opportunities, and a Sun–Jupiter conjunction in the 5th promises creative breakthroughs and a romantic spark. Wednesday is your power day because Mercury retrograde ends and the Sun aligns with your 10th House, spotlighting career recognition. Tuesday may feel heavy as Venus squares Saturn in the 7th, testing partnerships. Channel Thursday’s trine energy to pitch bold ideas at work. Follow for daily updates.
